# Urban Air Quality Assistant: Technical & Conceptual Framework ## Goal Description During severe winter smog episodes in metropolitan regions (driven by seasonal thermal inversions, biomass/stubble burning, vehicular emissions, and industrial stagnation), vulnerable families and communities suffer disproportionate acute and chronic health impacts. Conventional air quality apps merely display passive numbers (e.g., "AQI 420 - Hazardous") without providing contextual, accessible, or socioeconomically viable interventions. This project designs a **Generative AI-Powered Urban Air Quality Assistant** that transforms real-time hyper-local environmental data, meteorological forecasting, and user-specific constraints into: 1. **Personalized Action Plans**: Dynamic daily schedules, ventilation timing windows, and indoor filtration strategies. 2. **Accessible Sustainable Alternatives**: Socioeconomically tiered substitutions for high-emission habits and consumer items. 3. **Science-Based Impact Education**: Counterfactual impact modeling that transparently explains how individual/community choices directly improve health and local air quality. 4. **Contextual Awareness**: Real-time closed-loop adjustments based on fluctuating pollutants (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, O3, VOCs) and microclimate parameters. --- ## User Review Required > [!IMPORTANT] > **Free-Tier & Hackathon Constraints (PromptWars Challenge 6)**: The hackathon guidelines note that no GCP credits are provided, but any AI tool/model can be used. This framework is designed to operate seamlessly on free-tier APIs (e.g., Google Gemini 2.0/1.5 Flash via Google AI Studio API, OpenAQ, Open-Meteo) with zero mandatory infrastructure cost, while remaining architecturally ready for enterprise cloud scale. > [!WARNING] > **Clinical & Environmental Safety Guardrails**: Recommendations involving medical conditions (e.g., severe asthma, COPD, pediatric pulmonary risk) must strictly enforce guardrails. The AI assistant provides behavioral, environmental, and physical exposure mitigation strategies, not clinical diagnoses or prescription alterations. --- ## Open Questions 1. **Target Regional Context**: Should the initial reference dataset and persona localization target a specific high-smog urban ecosystem (e.g., Indo-Gangetic Plain / Delhi-NCR, Northern China, Central Valley California, or London/European winter smog corridors), or remain a generalized multi-region configuration? 2. **Deployment Footprint**: For the subsequent prototype phase, do you prefer a lightweight Progressive Web App (PWA) built with **Next.js + Tailwind + Gemini Flash**, or a **FastAPI backend with a chat widget**? --- ## Technical & Conceptual Framework ### 1. System Architecture & Technical Stack The architecture follows a modern **Event-Driven Agentic RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) & Deterministic Guardrail** design. Real-time data streams and user profiles are continuously harmonized through a hybrid decision engine before reaching the Generative LLM layer. ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph Data_Ingestion_Layer["1. Data Ingestion & Microclimate Layer"] S1["OpenAQ / WAQI APIs (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, AQI)"] S2["Open-Meteo / Weather APIs (Inversion, Temp, RH, Wind)"] S3["Indoor IoT / Manual Sensors (PM2.5, CO2, Humidity)"] S4["Satellite Feeds (Copernicus CAMS / Sentinel-5P AOD)"] end subgraph Streaming_Cache["2. Ingestion Pipeline & Cache"] Kafka["Event Stream / Redis Cache"] Aggregator["Hyper-Local Spatio-Temporal Normalizer"] end subgraph Core_Engine["3. Hybrid Intelligence & Decision Core"] ProfileDB["User Profile & Context Store (Housing, Health, Socioeconomics)"] MathRules["Deterministic Engine: Ventilation & Exposure Risk Index (OERI)"] VectorDB["Domain Knowledge RAG (WHO/EPA Standards, DIY Filtration Physics, Alternative Catalogs)"] LLMOrchestrator["Agentic Orchestrator (e.g. Gemini 2.0 Flash)"] end subgraph Agent_Subsystems["4. Specialized AI Micro-Agents"] AgentVent["Ventilation & Route Optimizer Agent"] AgentAlt["Socioeconomic Substitute Agent"] AgentEdu["Science & Impact Counterfactual Agent"] AgentGuard["Clinical Safety & Tone Guardrail Agent"] end subgraph Presentation_Layer["5. User Interaction & Multimodal Delivery"] PWA["Responsive Web / PWA UI (Dynamic Routine Timeline)"] PushEngine["Proactive Alert Push (Smart Window Open/Close)"] VoiceAudio["Voice / Vernacular Audio Synthesizer"] end Data_Ingestion_Layer --> Kafka Kafka --> Aggregator Aggregator --> MathRules ProfileDB --> MathRules ProfileDB --> LLMOrchestrator MathRules --> LLMOrchestrator VectorDB --> LLMOrchestrator LLMOrchestrator --> AgentVent LLMOrchestrator --> AgentAlt LLMOrchestrator --> AgentEdu AgentVent --> AgentGuard AgentAlt --> AgentGuard AgentEdu --> AgentGuard AgentGuard --> Presentation_Layer ``` #### Layer Breakdown | Layer | Component | Technology / Service | Role & Responsibility | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Ingestion** | Environmental Ingestion Workers | OpenAQ API, Open-Meteo, AirNow, PurpleAir | Polls/streams air pollutants and atmospheric boundary layer height every 15–30 mins. | | **Normalizer** | Geo-Spatial Resolution Engine | Python / Shapely / GeoPandas | Resolves GPS coordinates or neighborhood pincodes to local air quality sensor clusters and terrain-based microclimates. | | **State & Cache** | In-Memory Cache & State Store | Redis / SQLite / Supabase | Caches real-time AQI and user state to minimize LLM token usage and latency. | | **RAG Knowledge Base** | Domain Environmental & Health Vector DB | ChromaDB / pgvector / Qdrant | Embeds peer-reviewed studies (WHO, Lancet Planetary Health, EPA), DIY filtration engineering specs (Corsi-Rosenthal box physics), and regional product databases. | | **LLM Orchestrator** | Multi-Agent Reasoning Core | Google Gemini 2.0 Flash (Function Calling / Structured Outputs) | Ingests real-time parameters, triggers specialized agent prompts, outputs typed JSON action cards. | | **Guardrails** | Deterministic Safety Filter | NeMo Guardrails / Pydantic Validators | Validates clinical disclaimers, blocks hazardous folk remedies (e.g., burning materials indoors), ensures socioeconomic accessibility checks. | | **Client / Delivery** | Responsive Frontend & Notification Engine | Next.js 14 / Vite React + Tailwind CSS + WebPush API | Displays timeline cards, daily exposure meters, indoor ventilation countdowns, and conversational chat. | --- ### 2. Data Input Requirements & Comprehensive Taxonomy To make meaningful, hyper-local recommendations without excessive user friction, data inputs are grouped into four distinct categories: ```mermaid classDiagram class EnvironmentalTelemetry { +Float pm2_5 +Float pm10 +Float no2 +Float ozone +Float aqi_standard +Float temp_celsius +Float rel_humidity +Float wind_speed_kph +Float boundary_layer_height +Boolean thermal_inversion_detected } class IndoorBuiltEnvironment { +String housing_type +Boolean hvac_central +Boolean air_purifier_hepa +Boolean natural_ventilation_sealable +Float estimated_room_volume_m3 +String primary_cooking_fuel +Float indoor_pm25_reading (optional) +Float indoor_co2_ppm (optional) } class HealthVulnerability { +String age_category +Boolean respiratory_conditions (Asthma, COPD) +Boolean cardiovascular_history +Boolean is_pregnant +String exertion_profile (Sedentary, Outdoor manual labor, Commuter) } class SocioeconomicContext { +String income_bracket_tier (Tier 1 Low/Zero-Cost, Tier 2 Moderate, Tier 3 Commercial) +String primary_commute_mode (Walking, Cycling, Open Bus/Auto, AC Metro, Private Car) +String regional_locale +String preferred_language } EnvironmentalTelemetry <|-- IngestionContext IndoorBuiltEnvironment <|-- UserProfile HealthVulnerability <|-- UserProfile SocioeconomicContext <|-- UserProfile ``` #### Detailed Taxonomy Specification 1. **Macro & Micro Environmental Streams (External)**: - **Pollutant Concentrations**: $\text{PM}_{2.5}$ ($\mu\text{g/m}^3$), $\text{PM}_{10}$, $\text{NO}_2$, $\text{SO}_2$, $\text{CO}$, Ground-Level $\text{O}_3$. - **Boundary Layer & Inversion Dynamics**: Mixing layer height (meters), surface vs. upper atmospheric temperature delta ($\Delta T$). *Critical for predicting nocturnal smog trapping.* - **Meteorological Dispersion Indices**: Wind vector (direction & velocity), relative humidity (hygroscopic particle growth), precipitation probability, Solar UV radiation. 2. **Indoor Built Environment & Infrastructure**: - **Housing Fabric**: Leaky/open brickwork vs. modern sealed double-glazed windows; presence of gaps around doors/balconies. - **Filtration Assets**: Mechanical HEPA purifiers, existing ceiling/table fans, kitchen exhaust hoods, or zero active filtration. - **Indoor Emission Sources**: Fuel type (LPG vs. piped gas vs. kerosene/wood), incense/dhoop burning, mosquito coil usage, indoor deep-frying. 3. **Health Vulnerability & Lifestyle Profile**: - **High-Risk Cohorts**: Children ($<5$ yrs), elderly ($>65$ yrs), pregnant individuals, chronic respiratory/cardiac diagnoses. - **Daily Mobility Schedule**: Departure times, outdoor transit durations, school/work commute bottlenecks. 4. **Socioeconomic & Resource Constraints**: - **Intervention Tiering**: - *Tier 1 (Zero-Cost / Behavioral)*: Wet-mopping techniques, strategic window sealings using damp towels/newspapers, natural air-exchange timing, route detour shifts. - *Tier 2 (Low-Cost DIY)*: DIY Corsi-Rosenthal boxes (box fan + MERV13/HEPA filter panels costing $<\$20$), local anti-dust door sweeps, certified N95 masks. - *Tier 3 (Capital Investment)*: High-CADR commercial HEPA purifiers, smart indoor air quality monitors, electric induction cookers. --- ### 3. Persona and Tone Guidelines The assistant operates as an **Empathetic Community Environmental Health Guardian**. In high-pollution seasons, users frequently experience "smog fatigue," anxiety, eco-grief, and helplessness. The tone must never induce fatalism or guilt. #### Core Persona Attributes 1. **Empathetic & Grounded**: Acknowledges the physical discomfort (stinging eyes, throat irritation) and cognitive burden of living under hazardous smog without scolding or alarmist rhetoric. 2. **Authoritative & Science-Backed**: Backs advice with physical principles (e.g., explaining why $\text{PM}_{2.5}$ bypasses nasal cilia and enters the bloodstream) simplified into crisp metaphors. 3. **Culturally & Socioeconomically Sensitive**: Never suggests tone-deaf solutions (e.g., "Stay home in an air-conditioned room with 4 purifiers" to a daily-wage worker or commuter). Offers dignity-preserving, high-impact alternatives. 4. **Action-Oriented (Anti-Doomerism)**: Focuses on what the user *can* control rather than dwelling exclusively on macro-level air quality indices. #### Tone Matrix: What to Say vs. What NOT to Say | Scenario | ❌ Poor / Alarmist / Tone-Deaf Tone | ✅ Recommended Assistant Voice | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Severe AQI (450+) Outdoors** | "The air outside is toxic and deadly! Lock your doors and do not step outside under any circumstances or you risk severe lung damage." | "Outdoor air is currently in the severe range ($\text{PM}_{2.5}$ 380 $\mu\text{g/m}^3$) due to winter temperature inversion trapping smoke. If you need to head out for your morning commute, wearing a snug-fitting N95 mask will filter out over 95% of these fine particles. Let’s also keep your home’s road-facing windows closed until this afternoon when dispersion improves." | | **Low-Income Family with No Purifier** | "You should immediately buy two True HEPA air purifiers for your bedroom and living room to protect your children." | "Clean air doesn’t require costly appliances. Let’s set up a 'Clean Air Safe Corner' in your main bedroom. Using a damp cloth to seal the 1-inch gap under your balcony door and damp-mopping floors instead of sweeping prevents settled dust from becoming airborne. If you have an ordinary box fan, we can build a DIY filter for a fraction of the cost." | | **Cooking & Indoor Habits** | "Stop frying food or lighting incense immediately. You are polluting your own lungs." | "During severe winter inversion, smoke stays trapped indoors much longer. If you’re preparing food today, keeping the kitchen exhaust on or cracking the rear utility window while closing the door to the rest of the house keeps particulate matter from spreading to where your family sleeps." | --- ### 4. Decision Logic & Mapping: Environmental Interventions The mapping engine reconciles complex environmental variables with user contexts via a 3-stage pipeline: ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph Inputs E["Environmental Vector (AQI, BLH, Wind, Inversion)"] U["User Vector (Health, Housing, Socioeconomic Tier)"] end subgraph Stage1["Stage 1: Algorithmic Constraint Processing"] OERI["Calculate Outdoor Exposure Risk Index (OERI)"] OVWA["Calculate Optimal Ventilation Window (OVWA)"] end subgraph Stage2["Stage 2: Socioeconomic Tier Mapping"] TierFilter["Select Intervention Tier (Zero-Cost vs DIY vs Appliance)"] end subgraph Stage3["Stage 3: LLM Contextual Synthesis"] LLM["Generative Persona Engine (Gemini Flash)"] CardGen["Structured Action Cards (Time, Location, Benefit)"] end E --> OERI E --> OVWA U --> OERI U --> TierFilter OERI --> LLM OVWA --> LLM TierFilter --> LLM LLM --> CardGen ``` #### Mathematical Formulation ##### 1. Outdoor Exposure Risk Index ($OERI$) $$\text{OERI} = \min\left(10, \; \left( \frac{\text{PM}_{2.5}}{C_{\text{base}}} \cdot w_p + \frac{\text{NO}_2}{C_{\text{no2}}} \cdot w_n \right) \times V_{\text{vuln}} \times E_{\text{exertion}}\right)$$ - $C_{\text{base}}$: Baseline reference concentration (e.g., WHO 24-hr guideline: 15 $\mu\text{g/m}^3$). - $w_p, w_n$: Pollutant severity weights ($w_p = 0.75, w_n = 0.25$). - $V_{\text{vuln}}$: Vulnerability multiplier: - Healthy Adult: $1.0$ - Elderly / Child: $1.4$ - Asthmatic / COPD / Cardiac condition: $1.8$ - Asthmatic Child: $2.1$ - $E_{\text{exertion}}$: Physical activity factor: - Resting / Sitting: $1.0$ (Minute ventilation $\sim 6\text{–}8\text{ L/min}$) - Brisk Walk / Commute: $2.0$ (Minute ventilation $\sim 20\text{–}25\text{ L/min}$) - Running / Heavy Cycling: $4.5$ (Minute ventilation $\sim 60\text{–}80\text{ L/min}$) ##### 2. Optimal Ventilation Window Algorithm ($OVWA$) Ventilation is a trade-off between indoor $\text{CO}_2$ buildup ($>1000\text{ ppm}$ causes lethargy and headaches) and outdoor $\text{PM}_{2.5}$ ingress: $$\text{Ventilation Safety Score}(t) = \alpha \cdot \left(1 - \frac{\text{PM}_{2.5}(t)}{\text{Threshold}_{\text{peak}}}\right) + \beta \cdot \text{BLH}(t) + \gamma \cdot \text{WindSpeed}(t) - \delta \cdot \text{Inversion}(t)$$ - $\text{BLH}(t)$: Normalized boundary layer height (typically peaks between 13:00 and 16:00 when solar radiation breaks thermal inversion). - Inversion flag: 1 if upper air temperature is higher than surface; 0 otherwise. - **Rule Output**: System pinpoints a 20–30 minute window (typically 13:30–15:00) where outdoor concentrations are at diurnal nadir, instructing the user: *"Ventilate for 20 mins now with cross-breeze, then seal before 17:00 as temperatures drop and evening inversion sets in."* #### Comprehensive Decision Mapping Matrix | User Profile Archetype | Environmental State | Algorithmic Decision | Concrete AI Action Recommendation | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Single Mother, 2 Children (1 Asthmatic), Informal/Rented Flat, Tier 1 (Zero-Cost)** | AQI: 390 (Hazardous), Thermal Inversion Active, 07:30 AM | **OERI**: 9.4 (Extreme).
**Ventilation**: Hermetically sealed.
**Strategy**: Micro-zone isolation. | *"Keep roadside windows shut tight this morning. Create a 'Safe Sleeping Zone' in your inner bedroom using rolled damp towels along door cracks. Wet-mop rather than sweep to keep dust down. Postpone children's outdoor playtime until 2:30 PM when the sun disperses surface smoke."* | | **Outdoor Delivery Worker, 28 yrs, Motorbike Commuter, Tier 2 (Low-Cost DIY)** | AQI: 280 (Very Poor), Dry Cold, 08:30 AM Peak Traffic | **OERI**: 7.8 (High).
**Direct Exposure**: Severe vehicular $\text{NO}_2$ & $\text{PM}_{2.5}$. | *"On your motorbike route today, particulate levels at intersections are 2.5x higher than city averages. Wear an N95 mask (reuse cycle: 4 days if stored dry in paper bag). Avoid idling behind heavy diesel trucks at signals; breathe through your nose to leverage natural upper-airway filtering."* | | **Middle-Income Family, Apartment, Has 1 HEPA Purifier, Tier 2/3** | AQI: 420 (Peak Smog), Low Wind ($<3\text{ km/h}$), 06:00 PM | **OERI**: 8.2.
**Filtration**: Continuous.
**Indoor Air Hack**: Circulation boost. | *"Place your single HEPA purifier in the bedroom where your family spends 8 continuous sleeping hours, elevated 1 foot off the ground. Run your ceiling fan on the slowest clockwise speed to circulate filtered air without stirring floor dust."* | | **School Teacher / Jogger, Tier 2, Active Lifestyle** | AQI: 160 (Moderate/Unhealthy for Sensitive), 06:30 AM | **OERI**: 5.2 (elevated due to cardio). | *"Shift your morning outdoor run to an indoor HIIT/stretching session today. Morning winter smog is concentrated in the first 50 meters above ground until 11:00 AM. A 45-minute morning run today would equate to inhaling the particulate equivalent of 4 cigarettes."* | --- ### 5. Science-Based Impact Education & Counterfactual Simulator A key failure of existing environmental tools is the absence of **actionable agency**: users feel their small choices have no measurable effect. The assistant incorporates a **Counterfactual Environmental & Health Simulator**: ```mermaid flowchart TD UserChoice["User Choice: 'I switched my 3km commute from motorbike to Metro and wore an N95'"] Simulator["Impact Simulator Engine"] E1["Direct Inhalation Reduction: Prevents 420 μg of PM2.5 lung deposition"] E2["Community Emission Offset: Prevents 180g CO2 & 1.2g VOCs from tailpipe"] E3["Long-Term Health Translation: Avoids acute bronchial inflammation trigger"] UserChoice --> Simulator Simulator --> E1 Simulator --> E2 Simulator --> E3 ``` - **Translating Inhalation into Relatable Analogies**: - *"By wearing your N95 during today's 45-minute commute, you filtered out approximately $340\,\mu\text{g}$ of fine particulates—the equivalent of avoiding 3.5 secondhand cigarettes."* - **Community Multiplying Effect**: - *"If 50 families in your apartment block delay fireplace/biomass heating by 2 hours until the inversion lifts, neighborhood ground-level smoke density drops by up to 18%."* --- ### 6. Safety, Medical Guardrails & Disclaimers 1. **Non-Diagnostic Constraint**: System messages append a deterministic disclaimer whenever respiratory symptoms are mentioned: *"I provide environmental exposure mitigation guidance. If you or your child experience chest tightness, wheezing unresponsive to regular inhalers, or persistent breathlessness, consult your healthcare provider or emergency services immediately."* 2. **Combating Toxic Myths**: - The system vector store contains pre-vetted debunks for common dangerous folk remedies: - ❌ *"Burning camphor / essential oils purifies indoor smog"* $\rightarrow$ **Correction**: Generates harmful volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and ultrafine particles. - ❌ *"Boiling water with eucalyptus cleans the room"* $\rightarrow$ **Correction**: Elevates indoor humidity above 70%, accelerating dust-mite proliferation and particulate retention. - ❌ *"Ordinary surgical / cloth masks protect against winter smog"* $\rightarrow$ **Correction**: Fine $\text{PM}_{2.5}$ particles slip through gaps; only tight-seal N95/FFP2 masks are effective. --- ## Verification Plan ### Automated Tests 1. **API Integration & Data Parsing**: - Verify `OpenAQ` and `Open-Meteo` responses parse cleanly into typed Pydantic models. - Test fallback behavior when hyper-local station data is missing (interpolating nearest neighbor stations). 2. **Algorithmic Validation**: - Unit test the $OERI$ calculation across all vulnerability and exertion tiers. - Unit test the $OVWA$ ventilation window timing to confirm it never recommends ventilation during peak night/morning inversion periods. 3. **Guardrail & Prompt Red-Teaming**: - Test LLM responses with adversarial inputs (e.g., asking if burning wood indoors is safe, requesting medical prescriptions for asthma). Verify 100% adherence to safety guidelines. ### Manual Verification 1. **Socioeconomic Appropriateness**: - Run sample queries for Tier 1 (low income) vs. Tier 3 (high income) profiles to verify no tone-deaf commercial product recommendations leak into Tier 1 advice. 2. **Dynamic Responsiveness**: - Change simulated AQI from 80 (Moderate) to 480 (Hazardous) and verify that the generated daily routine dynamically adapts (cancels outdoor jogging, triggers sealed ventilation alerts).

> **PromptWars Virtual 2026 — Challenge 6: Urban Air Quality Assistant**

## 📌 Executive Summary & Problem Statement

During severe winter smog episodes in metropolitan regions (such as the Indo-Gangetic Plain, Northern China, Central Valley California, and London corridors), seasonal **thermal inversions** trap particulate matter ($\text{PM}_{2.5}$, $\text{PM}_{10}$), $\text{NO}_2$, and combustion smoke close to ground level. 

Existing air quality applications merely report passive numbers (e.g., *"AQI 425 - Hazardous"*), triggering anxiety without actionable, equitable interventions. Families in informal or drafty housing cannot afford multi-thousand dollar commercial purifiers, nor can daily commuters simply avoid going outdoors.

**AuraGuard AI** addresses this gap by providing an end-to-end, empathetic, and science-grounded assistant that dynamically adapts to **hyper-local microclimate physics**, **socioeconomic reality**, and **individual pulmonary vulnerabilities**.

---

## 🌟 Key Capabilities (Aligned with Challenge 6)

### 1. Personalized 24-Hour Smog Action Plans
- **Diurnal Smog Synchronization**: Automatically synchronizes daily recommendations with atmospheric boundary layer dynamics.
- **Smart Ventilation Window ($OVWA$)**: Pinpoints the optimal 20–45 minute afternoon window when solar thermal heating lifts the boundary layer, allowing fresh air exchange without soot ingress.
- **Microclimate Route & Habit Shifts**: Adapts guidance based on commute mode (walking, two-wheeler, bus, or metro) to shield vulnerable airways during morning rush hours.

### 2. Socioeconomically-Tiered Interventions & DIY Hacks
- **Tier 1 (Zero-Cost Behavioral)**: Damp-cloth doorway infiltration barriers, negative-pressure kitchen isolation, and wet-mopping vs. broom aerosolization mechanics.
- **Tier 2 (Low-Cost DIY)**: Interactive **Corsi-Rosenthal Box** CADR calculator ($15–$25 air cleaner delivering 220+ CFM of clean air) and N95 paper-bag rotation protocols.
- **Tier 3 (Capital Investment)**: HEPA purifier placement optimization and gentle air stratification mixing.

### 3. Science-Based Impact Education & Counterfactual Simulator
- **Biological Mechanism Explanations**: Accessible breakdowns of how sub-micron $\text{PM}_{2.5}$ particles bypass nasal cilia to cause alveolar capillary inflammation.
- **Counterfactual Exposure Calculator**: Real-time simulation of biological outcomes (micrograms of $\text{PM}_{2.5}$ spared from lung deposition, Berkeley Earth secondhand cigarette equivalents avoided, and community tailpipe $\text{CO}_2$ emissions offset).

### 4. Empathetic, Culturally Sensitive GenAI Assistant
- **Empathetic Community Guardian Persona**: Tone-engineered to avoid "doomerism" and smog fatigue, focusing on agency and dignity.
- **Google Gemini 2.0 Integration**: Uses Google Gemini Flash with structured prompt conditioning, supported by an intelligent zero-config local fallback engine for uninterrupted offline evaluation.
- **Multimodal Accessibility**: Integrated Web Speech text-to-speech audio for low-literacy or on-the-go community access.

## 🔬 Mathematical Formulations

### 1. Outdoor Exposure Risk Index ($OERI$)
$$\text{OERI} = \min\left(10, \; \left( \frac{\text{PM}_{2.5}}{15} \cdot 0.75 + \frac{\text{NO}_2}{25} \cdot 0.25 \right) \times V_{\text{vuln}} \times E_{\text{exertion}} \times 0.35\right)$$
- $V_{\text{vuln}}$: Vulnerability multiplier (1.0 for healthy adults, up to 1.9 for asthmatics/infants).
- $E_{\text{exertion}}$: Physical activity multiplier (1.0 for sealed transit, 2.4 for cycling/walking).

import json
import os
import re

transcript_path = r'C:\Users\ADMIN\.gemini\antigravity\brain\305b43f0-812d-4de9-92fa-35dcf74496d9\.system_generated\logs\transcript_full.jsonl'
output_dir = r'E:\promptwars challenge 6\chat'

md_output_path = os.path.join(output_dir, 'CONVERSATION_CHAT_HISTORY.md')
clean_txt_path = os.path.join(output_dir, 'CHAT_TRANSCRIPT.txt')

entries = []

with open(transcript_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    for line in f:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        try:
            step = json.loads(line)
        except Exception:
            continue
        
        source = step.get('source')
        stype = step.get('type')
        content = step.get('content', '')
        created_at = step.get('created_at', '')

        # Filter for actual user queries and assistant responses
        if source == 'USER_EXPLICIT' and stype == 'USER_INPUT':
            # Clean internal tags like <USER_REQUEST> if present
            clean_content = re.sub(r'</?USER_REQUEST>', '', content).strip()
            # Remove additional metadata block from user text for cleaner reading
            clean_content = re.sub(r'<ADDITIONAL_METADATA>[\s\S]*?</ADDITIONAL_METADATA>', '', clean_content).strip()
            if clean_content:
                entries.append({
                    'role': 'USER',
                    'time': created_at,
                    'content': clean_content
                })
        elif source == 'MODEL' and stype == 'PLANNER_RESPONSE':
            if content and content.strip():
                entries.append({
                    'role': 'ASSISTANT (AuraGuard AI / Antigravity)',
                    'time': created_at,
                    'content': content.strip()
                })

# Write to Markdown
with open(md_output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as out_md:
    out_md.write("# 💬 Full Chat & Conversation Transcript\n")
    out_md.write("### Project: AuraGuard AI | PromptWars Virtual 2026 — Challenge 6: Urban Air Quality Assistant\n")
    out_md.write(f"**Total Dialog Turns:** {len(entries)}\n\n")
    out_md.write("---\n\n")

    for i, entry in enumerate(entries, 1):
        role = entry['role']
        time = entry['time']
        text = entry['content']

        if role == 'USER':
            out_md.write(f"## 👤 Turn {i} — User ({time})\n\n")
            out_md.write(f"{text}\n\n")
            out_md.write("---\n\n")
        else:
            out_md.write(f"## 🤖 Turn {i} — Assistant ({time})\n\n")
            out_md.write(f"{text}\n\n")
            out_md.write("---\n\n")

# Write to Clean Text
with open(clean_txt_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as out_txt:
    out_txt.write("=====================================================================\n")
    out_txt.write("FULL CONVERSATION CHAT TRANSCRIPT — PROMPTWARS CHALLENGE 6\n")
    out_txt.write("=====================================================================\n\n")
    for i, entry in enumerate(entries, 1):
        out_txt.write(f"[{entry['role']} - {entry['time']}]\n")
        out_txt.write(entry['content'] + "\n")
        out_txt.write("\n" + "-" * 70 + "\n\n")

print(f"Exported {len(entries)} turns to:")
print(f"1. {md_output_path}")
print(f"2. {clean_txt_path}")
